【ENDED】The market and food truck pop-ups at Hanno City Hall closed on June 30, 2026 (Reiwa 8). They ran as a lunch-time trial from April through June. Food trucks appeared almost daily; markets set up weekly on the main building's wood deck. Vendors offered a range of items: grilled chicken, curry, samosas, tea, jam, chimaki (bamboo-wrapped rice dumplings), dango (sweet rice balls), roasted corn snacks, and more. Seating with "hashira benches" (wooden benches) was available on the first-floor wood deck of the main building. Advance reservations could be made by contacting individual vendors the day before, though purchases without reservation were also possible.
summary: 📢 June too! / Hanno City Hall food truck and market pilot wraps up
